source_locations_read.A2.p1: We used the R 2 R^{2} score (coefficient of determination) to measure the performance of the regression models. R 2 R^{2} is computed as follows: R 2 = 1 − ∑ i = 1 N ( y ^ i − y i ) 2 ∑ i = 1 N ( y i − y ¯ ) 2 , R^{2}=1-\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{N}(\hat{y}_{i}-y_{i})^{2}}{\sum_{i=1}^{N}(y_{i}-\bar{y})^{2}}, (12) where y ^ i \hat{y}_{i} is a predicted value of the regression model, y i y_{i} is the ground-truth, and y ¯ = ( 1 / N ) ​ ∑ i = 1 N y i \bar{y}=(1/N)\sum_{i=1}^{N}y_{i} is the mean of the ground truth values. R 2 R^{2} is close to 1 when the regression model is accurate.
